Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics is Kwame Adjei-Rowe's account. It moved to him on 22 November 2025, and Bettina confirmed in #coastal-team this week that it stays with Kwame.

"PHL" also means Pellow Home Living, your Mid-Atlantic retail account, so check which one the ticket is about before you forward it. If it's about the Gulf Coast terminal (drayage, gates, chassis pools, yard), send it to Kwame. If it's about Pellow's doors, appointments or the retail export, it's yours.
